title: Not quality toys
text: [[VIDEOID:70410e1fb4206c7d2c1b2cbb321ddaf0]] My Male cat enjoyed the treats the rest of the box was pretty worthless. Neither cat cared one bit about the toys.  The main toy is horribly designed.  A cat would not be strong enough to pull the elastic band out enough to get food out. Plus odds are their nails would get stuck in the ball when they tried to pull it down.
label: negative
